$comment: What scripts/verify-window.mjs judges a window's members by, read at the window's BASE commit so a member cannot loosen the rule it is judged by. A surface is ineligible where its defects are green on the developer's run and red only under the whole gate: process-wide state, the environment or PATH, concurrency and ordering, or a platform that run does not execute on (ISS-1312 measured all four). Such a change takes the whole gate in its own run. When unsure, exclude: a wrong exclusion costs one run its own gate, a wrong admission costs every member of the window. How the window works: docs/modules/landing/verify-window.md.

gate.$comment: What a window validates its combination with, once: the sweeps a developer run no longer pays, plus the entry layer over the combination's diff (scripts/lib/verify-layers.mjs). prepare readies a fresh tree for it; CI's ci-passed on the window's pull request remains the required check.

union.reason: every pull request adds its entry at the head of [Unreleased], so any two conflict on the same lines and both entries are meant to stand; check-release-record still judges the result

paths.reason: CI builds and tests the runner on Linux, macOS and Windows while a developer run executes one of them; ISS-1312 met a CRLF miss that only Windows showed
the workflow is the shared gate itself, so a change to it is judged by the run it changes rather than by a window it would be validating
a manifest change moves how every package resolves its modules, which is process-wide for every suite in the window
the lockfile decides what every package installs; two members re-deriving it from one base land on a file neither of them tested
the workspace file decides which packages exist and how they link, which every suite in the window resolves through
node-linker=hoisted is what lets packages resolve from the repository root; a change to it moves resolution for every suite at once
the task graph decides which suites run and in what order, so it is ordering for the whole gate
a vitest configuration sets the pool, the parallelism and the setup files every test process of that package shares
a setup file runs inside every test process of its package, so its state is process-wide by construction
the whole-tree guard is installed into every vitest process as a setup file and watches every child process a test starts
the integration suite's shared database harness, which every integration file and its container go through
the gate's own entrypoint: a change to what the gate runs, or to which layer a check is in, is judged by the whole gate it changes, never by a window validating with it
a checker the gate runs: a change to what it measures moves the verdict on every member of a window, not only on this one
the conformance levels and audit read every axis, so a change to them moves the verdict on the whole tree
the libraries the checkers and the window itself run on, including the journal reader every migration is numbered by
the gate's declarations, baselines and binaries, this file included: a member may not change the rule a window judges it by

lines.reason: PATH is read by every child process a test starts; ISS-1312 measured a PATH race failing 266 of 300 runs that the member's own run never showed
writing the environment changes it for every test sharing the process, so it passes alone and fails under the whole suite's order
the working directory and the umask belong to the process, not to the test that changed them
a process-level handler outlives the code that installed it and sees every other test's failures
a lock or a skip-locked claim is concurrency and ordering, which a scoped unloaded run cannot exercise
threads and shared memory are concurrency the developer's run executes once, in one order
